lessons_stated.value: Marking 15m order blocks / FVGs shows where price could react; it is not a signal, and it does not mean take a trade there
lessons_stated.ref: [07:45]-[08:15] 'this is not the signals chat ... not a signal video ... marking out fifteen minute [order] blocks ... does not mean ... take a trade off'

lessons_stated.value: Practise marking up analysis even on days you don't trade
lessons_stated.ref: [08:30]-[08:45] 'even if i'm not in a trade i can see my analysis ... do that in your free time'

lessons_stated.value: Pre-open plan: wait for price to sweep the lower pre-market lows for confluence, then look for entries in a marked zone, then expect price higher
lessons_stated.ref: [06:45]-[07:15] 'looking for prices come ... into one of these lower [lows] ... look for some sort of entries within ... pushing up ... higher'

lessons_stated.value: The strategy is fractal: draw on liquidity from a higher timeframe, structure on a lower one (e.g. 4h draws with 30m; here a 15m draw with 5m structure)
lessons_stated.ref: [16:15]-[17:00] 'if you go to a four hour ... look for draws ... thirty minute ... fifteen minute ... structure your goal is on a five minute'

lessons_stated.value: Just because he made a YouTube video on a strategy doesn't mean he uses it every day
lessons_stated.ref: [21:45]-[22:15] 'i made a youtube video on ... a strategy that i no longer use'
